name: WILMA Scholarship (TAFE NSW, Macarthur)
summary: $1,500 for a woman in the Macarthur region facing financial or personal barriers to TAFE NSW study.
key: TAFE NSW will award $1,500 to empower a woman from the Macarthur region.
who: Woman by birth or identity who lives or studies in the Macarthur area.
Enrolled or planning to enrol in a nationally accredited TAFE NSW course in Semester 2, 2026.
Australian citizen, permanent resident, humanitarian visa holder or NZ citizen.
Shows significant barriers to study, such as financial hardship or recovering from family or domestic violence.
how: Use the Apply now button and select 'WILMA Scholarship' from the scholarship drop-down.

evidence.quote: TAFE NSW will award $1,500 to empower a woman from the Macarthur region
Applications for the 2026 WILMA Scholarship close 5 pm (AEDT) Friday, 23 October 2026.
